function.name: tool_2

function.name: tool_3
function.description: 系统工具：mapping.status。审批前只读查询：读取扫描进度和当前地图

function.name: tool_4
function.description: 系统工具：navigation.status。审批前只读查询：读取融合后的导航与定位摘要，不返回栅格或传感器帧

function.name: tool_5
function.description: 系统工具：runtime.readiness。审批前只读查询：只读采集与反馈新鲜度诊断；不授权运动

function.name: tool_6

function.name: tool_7
